Resolves #19600

The native history witness popped out the full-width Feed strip. A header pop-out opens at the pane's footprint (#19598), so that 1176×240 popup found no two free positions beside the main window, and the case failed before its history assertions ran. It now pops out the right-column Commits pane (about 355×519), which fits. `freePopupPlacement` and every history and geometry assertion are unchanged, as Euclid (author of #19480) asked.

Evidence: L2 (browser e2e, headless) → L2 required (test-only). Residual: none.
